paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how BLEU score varies with Average Lagging (AL) for four methods (Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi). The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and uses a linear scale, spanning roughly from about −1 to about 7.5, with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, and 6. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28 with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 BLEU. The Consistency-CE series is drawn as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, rising from about 13 BLEU at AL just below 0 to about 26.4 BLEU at AL a bit above 7, with intermediate points near 19.8 (AL≈1), 22.4 (AL≈4), and 24.8 (AL≈5.8–6). The Inconsistency-CE series is shown as a darker purple dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 20 BLEU at AL just under 1 to about 27.0 BLEU at AL a bit above 7, passing through points near 22.6 (AL≈2), 24.9 (AL≈4), and 26.1 (AL≈5.8–6). The Inconsistency-CE-MP series appears as a blue dashed line with square markers, also increasing across the x-range from about 19.8 BLEU at AL just under 1 to about 27.2 BLEU at AL a bit above 7, with points around 22.7 (AL≈2), 24.9 (AL≈4), and 26.0 (AL≈5.8–6). The Consistency-Bi series is a red solid line with star markers, rising from about 22.6 BLEU at AL slightly below 0 to about 27.8 BLEU at AL a bit above 7, with intermediate values near 24.2 (AL≈1.5–2), 25.9 (AL≈3.5–4), and 26.8 (AL≈5.8–6).
